title: Leui Ben
summary: Raleigh names Leui Ben in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Leui Ben, the rest of whose name is a blank, hath a contrarie opinion of the sonnes of Eli forcing the women, and is not Leui who had three sonnes. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
